record.question: A Deputy SP receives repeated complaints from citizens regarding discourteous behaviour by a subordinate officer. Without conducting any inquiry, he ignores the complaints for several months. The misconduct continues and public confidence in the police suffers. Which provision of the CCS (Conduct) Rules is most closely engaged?
options: Only Rule 3A applies to the subordinate officer
The supervisory officer may also fail in his obligation to ensure devotion to duty and proper conduct
No rule applies to supervisory inaction
Only disciplinary rules, not conduct rules, are relevant
